parameters.name: AdviceDate
parameters.description: The date when the optimization suggestions were generated. Specify the date in the `yyyyMMdd` format. The date is in UTC.

parameters.name: AdviceIdList
parameters.description: The IDs of the optimization suggestions that you want to apply. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: BuildImmediately
parameters.description: Specifies whether to immediately start the build task.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data warehouse cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of data warehouse clusters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
